payload.title: The web client reads any failed token refresh as a dead session (clearSession) and spends a refresh on an UNAUTHENTICATED answer to a token issued seconds ago, so a throttled refresh signs the user out and a subgraph that rejects a valid session drains the per-IP refresh budget on every page load
evidence: web/shared-ui/src/utils/api-client.ts:945 (refreshAccessToken cleared the session on any failure)
web/shared-ui/src/utils/api-client.ts:829 (request(): refresh on every UNAUTHENTICATED answer)
payload.rule_violated: A refresh that could not be answered (throttled, server fault, offline) never ends the session; only a refused refresh does
payload.notes: Fixed: RefreshOutcome (ok / rejected / unavailable) with a cooldown that honours the server's wait, and no refresh for a token whose iat is under 30 s old.
narrative: Audit crawl 2026-10-26: a second refreshToken per page load, caused by GetUnreadNotificationCount answering UNAUTHENTICATED to a token issued seconds before; the 5th page load was sent to /login.
